querystring.select: SELECT  CPFD.MONTHLY_INCOME_AMT AS MthIncAmt, CPFD.MONTHLY_EXPENSE_AMT AS MthExpAmt, CPFD.MONTHLY_INSTALLMENT_AMT AS MthInsAmt,RMINC.DESCR AS SrcOthInc, CPFD.SPOUSE_MONTHLY_INCOME_AMT AS SpsMthIncAmt, CPFD.IS_JOIN_INCOME AS IsJoinInc
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST_PERSONAL_FIN_DATA CPFD WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.CUST_PERSONAL CP WITH(NOLOCK) ON CP.CUST_PERSONAL_ID = CPFD.CUST_PERSONAL_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMINC WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMINC.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'SOURCE_INCOME' AND RMINC.MASTER_CODE = CPFD.MR_SOURCE_OF_INCOME_CODE
